picks.title: Sync.Labs Intros Zero-Shot Lipsyncing for Film and Television
picks.excerpt: Sync.Labs launched Sync.Productions, bringing its studio-grade zero-shot AI lipsync technology to film and television production for dubbing and dialogue fixes.
picks.rationale: New product launch (Sync.Productions) that post teams can use right away for dubbing and dialogue fixes. The most actionable item in the pool.

picks.title: Reallusion and Escape.AI Partner to Solve AI Video Bottlenecks and Expand Distribution
picks.excerpt: A strategic alliance connects Reallusion's 3D character/animation ecosystem with John Gaeta's Escape.AI Neo Cinema platform to tackle control bottlenecks in AI video and widen distribution.
picks.rationale: New tool partnership that pairs 3D character control with AI video, addressing the controllability problem directly. Adds a pipeline/tools angle.

picks.title: How AI Is Used by Netflix at Its VFX Eyeline Studios, Revealed by VP Mohsen Mousavi at View Conference
picks.excerpt: Eyeline VP Mohsen Mousavi reveals how Netflix uses AI for crowds, sets and relighting, while developing new tools for filmmaking.
picks.rationale: Concrete studio use cases (crowds, set extension, relighting) from a different exec at a different event (VIEW, Turin) than the 10-11 Rustad/Busan card.

picks.title: MIPCOM: 'Journey to the West - The Lost Five Hundred Years' First Look Revealed by Utopai & Huace
picks.excerpt: Utopai Studios and Huace revealed a first look at 'Journey to the West - The Lost Five Hundred Years,' a fully AI-generated prequel series inspired by the classic Chinese novel.
picks.rationale: First look at a fully AI-generated series. It is a new project reveal, separate from Utopai's PAI tool launch (10-01) and the Banderas 'Cortes' feature (10-13).

picks.title: It's 'incomprehensible' that Instagram allowed an AI image of Mia Goth to spread, say her reps
picks.excerpt: Mia Goth's representatives say they filed multiple complaints with Instagram about a fan account posting AI-generated images of the actor - a fresh flashpoint over performer likeness.
picks.rationale: New performer-likeness incident with platform-moderation stakes. Adds a rights angle and a fifth outlet.

alternates.title: 'IvyBears' Hits Cannes After YouTube Breakout, Spawns Animated Feature Project (EXCLUSIVE)
alternates.excerpt: From consumer products to character-driven series, IvyBears goes brand-to-content in a 'reverse flywheel' approach powered by AI and artists alike, now spawning an animated feature.
alternates.rationale: Fresh and new, but it would be a second MIPCOM AI-series card. First alternate if a pick is swapped.
